_comment: Runs of the conformance suite (spec/IR_SPEC.md section 11.4): one results file per engine, with every case's verdict and detail; each run names the keramos tag and commit it ran against. v1.4.1 has 467 cases (v1.4.1 added the trace and acceptance case of relative_kv under weight_index, which ember's v1.4.0 receipt predates; v1.4.0 465, v1.4.0 added the 28 cases of attention.relative_kv and Primer's MDHA, section 12.6; llama.cpp, transformers and ONNX Runtime GenAI have no path for any of them, IR-only models or single nodes or documents, so their v1.3.5 receipts stand; v1.3.5 437, adding the six tensor_index cases of section 7.2; v1.3.4 431, adding the 18 cases of tp_llama_hd16, tp_mistral_hd16 and tp_qwen3_hd16; v1.3.3 413, v1.3.1 408, v1.3.0 404, v1.2.0 370); each run names its tag. SKIP means the engine has no path for the case (the reference: the gradient cases, which are its own finite differences; mtstudio: the single ops it has no kernel path for, sessions other than its scored traces, document loading, refusals and acceptance, dequantisation, chat rendering; the clean-room Rust engine: the gradient cases and render_chat; ember: single ops other than recurrence, expr and attention, and the gradient cases). reference_environment.json is the generating environment's receipt (IR_SPEC 4.6), not a run of an engine. llama.cpp is the first engine measured that was not written against the spec: its FAILs are classified in adapters/llamacpp/FINDINGS.txt. transformers (5.20.2, torch 2.14.1+cpu) is measured through an export of each GGUF to an HF checkpoint (adapters/common/gguf_to_hf.py); its FAILs and the GGUF reader's are classified in adapters/hf/FINDINGS.txt. ONNX Runtime GenAI (0.18.0, onnxruntime 1.31.1, CPU) is measured through the same export and its own model builder: its FAILs and the builder's and kernel's refusals are classified in adapters/ortgenai/FINDINGS.txt.

runs.engine: numpy reference (tools/ir_numpy.py) (CPython 3.13.14, numpy 2.3.5, Windows 11 x86-64: the generating environment), against keramos v1.4.1 (a29ce6f596e2e79c6fca52e6382c962cb5f7011e)
paperkiln mtstudio, CPU, with ir_eval and expr_eval (ext4 clone of paperkiln 43e32a05; Release, GCC 13.3, -ffp-contract=off), against keramos v1.4.1 (a29ce6f596e2e79c6fca52e6382c962cb5f7011e)
keramos-cleanroom (Rust, cleanroom/rust at keramos 1d1fd377; rustc 1.98.1, release, no crates, WSL ext4), against keramos v1.4.1 (a29ce6f596e2e79c6fca52e6382c962cb5f7011e)
ember.cpp ir_adapter, CPU interpreter, ember b49eb5c16852e1120d10db82b9616f05c754b8c2, against keramos v1.4.1 (a29ce6f596e2e79c6fca52e6382c962cb5f7011e)
